enrichment.summary: Configures anti-phishing protections in Defender for Office 365 with aggressive detection thresholds, spoof intelligence honouring DMARC, impersonation protection for organisational domains, and safety tips to minimise phishing risks.
enrichment.rationale: Deploying this policy helps organisations protect against phishing attacks by enhancing detection capabilities, preventing domain and user impersonation, and providing users with safety tips to identify suspicious emails.
enrichment.licensing: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 (Microsoft 365 E5)
